project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, estates, nature reserves and neighbouring settlements do not inflate the place score. Score corrected after removal of the artificial sub-60 catalogue gate. Settlement merit was assessed before applying the map threshold; standalone attractions were not transferred into the town score.
